chapter_summary: This is the Part II divider page, a business-of-trading essay (not a technical chapter): trade selection discipline, market/instrument choice, chart timeframe and bar-construction trade-offs, and position sizing as the path to bigger profits once consistently profitable. It contains no new mechanical bar-by-bar conditions - the trade-selection ideas it references (second entries at new swing highs/lows, spikes and pullbacks on trend days) are primitives already mined in the pattern chapters.
